name: comic-universe
description: Targeted source read supports this narrow assessment: Electron updater disables differential/web installer behavior and uses the electron-updater release path; generated latest manifest SHA-512 is the available integrity mechanism and release signing settings are weak.
limitations: The retained snapshot does not establish current released artifact behavior or upstream configuration.
Where verification is delegated to an external framework/package, that implementation was not vendored and remains unresolved.
